full_name: Krassimira Daskalova | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 History Joy Foundation Fellow Sofia University St. Kliment Ohridski (Bulgaria)
bio: Krassimira Daskalova is a professor of modern European cultural history at Sofia University St. Kliment Ohridski, in Bulgaria. Her most recent monograph is Women, Gender, and Modernization in Bulgaria, 1878–1944 (in Bulgarian), published by Sofia University Press in 2012.
